records.text: Exarch Larethor is an Aldor draenei working with the Shattered Sun Offensive against the Legion. Practical and direct, he stresses that the Aldor and Scryers must cooperate because neither has the strength to face the threat alone. He is concerned when his Magisters' Terrace contact Tyrith stops reporting, and later mourns Tyrith while recognizing that his gathered intelligence served the mission.

Shattered Sun Marksmen are ranged fighters serving the Sunwell campaign. They appear across several areas of the campaign and hold their positions while out of combat, ready to respond when threats engage them.
Wretched Devourers are hostile humanoids in the Sunwell region. One claims, “Mine! You shall not take this place!” and uses Mana Tap in combat, presenting its hold on the area as something to defend.

Vindicator Xayann is a Shattered Sun planner at the staging area who devised replacement crystal cores for the malfunctioning sentries. The plan turns defeated sentries into friendly units for tactical guard posts, helping secure the sanctum and extend the perimeter. Xayann's focus is using repaired sentries to strengthen the operation's defenses.
A Wretched Fiend is a hostile Wretched occupying Sun's Reach and Dawning Square. It warns intruders that the place belongs to its kind, then fights with Sunder Armor.

Captain Theris Dawnhearth directs Shattered Sun efforts to secure Sun's Reach Sanctum, restore its wards, and extend defenses to nearby structures; the sanctum's energy could open a portal from Shattrath. Theris treats the Wretched as a threat to the operation. A missing operative sent to investigate the fel portal at Dawning Square prompts Theris to provide a captured Legion scroll, believed to grant access, and direct the recipient to find Magistrix Seyla.
An Erratic Sentry reports a core overload and system malfunction, fitting its role as a malfunctioning guard near Sun's Reach.

Mar'nah is an alchemist at Sun's Reach Harbor who develops useful reagents and elixirs. She describes using Razorthorn flayer glands to control a ravager and expose roots, and says Sunwell-touched bloodberries can be distilled into an ability-enhancing elixir. Her replies are brisk when occupied, but she thanks those who help.
A Blood Knight in Kael'thas's elite Dawnblade army stationed at Sun's Reach Harbor, this soldier casts Holy Light when badly wounded.
A Summoner in Kael'thas's elite Dawnblade army stationed at Sun's Reach Harbor, this soldier casts Fel Armor upon returning.
A Marksman in Kael'thas's elite Dawnblade army stationed at Sun's Reach Harbor, this soldier casts Flaming Arrow while out of combat.
A Crystal Ward in the Isle of Quel'Danas.
A mechanical Shattered Sun Sentry on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Irespeaker is a combatant that uses Fel Fireball when its opponent is out of melee range and Fel Consumption when the opponent closes in.
Abyssal Flamewalker casts Abyssal Meteor Fall when it appears.
Unleashed Hellion uses War Stomp and Rain of Fire in combat.
A frenzied undead ghoul that fights in the Dead Scar. When badly wounded, it lashes out with Thrash.
A skeletal undead combatant found among the forces in the Dead Scar. When badly wounded, it lashes out with Thrash.
A Wrath Enforcer serving among the enemy forces in the Dead Scar, targeted by the Shattered Sun's continuing air strikes. It casts a spell while in combat.
A powerful Pit Overlord among the enemy forces in the Dead Scar, targeted by the Shattered Sun's continuing air strikes. In combat, it attacks with Cleave.

Eldara Dawnrunner serves as quartermaster for the Shattered Sun Offensive. She treats returning champions as valued comrades, crediting them with helping the offensive survive and succeed; her banter imagines the Dawnblade fearing their return. The campaign's gratitude spans the Aldor and Scryers working together.

An Eredar Sorcerer is a combatant among the Legion's forces in the Dead Scar. It is one of the enemies targeted in the Sun's Reach air strikes, alongside Pit Overlords and Wrath Enforcers. In battle, it casts Flames of Doom.
Tradesman Portanuus is a trade-supplies merchant. He greets visitors as friends.
Tyrael Flamekissed is a general-goods vendor who lets visitors browse his wares.
Caregiver Inaara is an innkeeper who welcomes guests with an invitation to sit and make themselves comfortable, giving her greeting a hospitable, reassuring tone.
Seraphina Bloodheart is a stable master who greets visitors and offers help with stabling pets or recovering lost companions. Her work centers on travelers and their animal companions.
Kaalif is a reagent vendor who lets visitors browse his wares.
Sereth Duskbringer is a poison supplier who offers goods for browsing.

Smith Hauthaa is outfitting Sun's Reach forces and presses ahead while supplies are uncertain. She is building an anvil to make their weapons and armor, and expects to offer more powerful work once it is ready.

Battlemage Arynna is a Sun's Reach battlemage coordinating the campaign against the Burning Legion at the Dead Scar. She favors an aerial diversion to weaken the demons while allied forces seize the armory, and remains focused on the continuing fight after its capture.

Ayren Cloudbreaker is a veteran dragonhawk pilot working from Sun's Reach Harbor near the front. Though he says his line of work offers little action, he welcomes this combat-zone assignment. He supports air strikes against the Legion and Dawnblade reinforcements by providing dragonhawk flights.
Darkspine Myrmidons are numerous hostile combatants found in the waters near Sun's Reach. In combat, they use Sunder Armor and Demoralizing Shout.

Harbinger Inuuro speaks as a commander in the campaign on Quel'Danas. He says that after taking Sun's Reach Sanctum, the armory is the next objective because it is tactically important. He urges continued attacks on the Burning Legion, describing its emissaries as shock troops who help rally the enemy, and frames defeating them as a way to damage Legion morale.
Dawnblade Hawkriders are combatants found in two areas of Quel'Danas.

At Sun's Reach Armory, Magister Ilastar advocates attacks on Kael'thas's Dawnblade forces, describing them as an elite army and their casualties as useful to the campaign. His satisfaction is personal: he hopes Kael'thas feels despair, helplessness, or fear, and says the Dawnblade soldiers sealed their fate by following him.
Darkspine Sirens are creatures found in Quel'Danas.
Greengill Slaves are found in large numbers in Quel'Danas. When hit by an Orb of Murloc Control, a Greengill Slave casts Greengill Slave Freed.
Dawnblade Reservists are part of the fleet sent to reinforce Kael's forces at Sun's Reach. They defend the ships targeted in the harbor assault, fighting after the sails are set ablaze.

Captain Valindria oversees the effort to disrupt the naga on Greengill Coast after Sun's Reach Harbor is taken. She considers the operation her responsibility and directs the attack on the controlling orbs enslaving the local murlocs. She cautions against causing so much disruption that the naga turn their attention directly toward her side.

Vindicator Kaalan focuses on securing Sun's Reach harbor and preventing Dawnblade reinforcements. Confident that denying the fleet will help bring victory, Kaalan proposes dragonhawk raids through Ayren Cloudbreaker, using flaming oil against ship sails to leave the reservists vulnerable.

Anchorite Ayuri works to honor the war's fallen and support their bereaved families. Ayuri raises funds for a memorial and aid to spouses and orphans, regarding remembrance as only a small consolation for their loss. Victory must not erase the cost of war or the sacrifices that made it possible.
A Shattered Sun Warrior is one of the Shattered Sun's combatants, represented in numbers across several areas of the Isle of Quel'Danas.

A Sunblade Lookout keeps watch in multiple areas of the Isle of Quel'Danas. The lookouts' hostility toward the Shattered Sun is explicit: one denounces them as scum and calls for its forces to open fire.

Astromancer Darnarian is an exacting portal worker who objects to people expecting effortless translocation. He gives out an Astromancer's Crystal and asks visitors to take readings at three ley-line sites, using the exercise to make them appreciate the work behind portals. When the crystal is returned, he checks the readings and warns that faulty measurements could send the user somewhere unintended, leaving them responsible for the result.
Shattered Sun bombardiers serve amid the Sunwell campaign: one warns of an incoming dragonhawk and calls for it to be shot down, while another says their attention is on demons rather than Scourge.
Brutallus is a demon on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Madrigosa is a dragonkin on the Isle of Quel'Danas.

Drill Sergeant Bahduum runs a hard-pressed Shattered Sun force on Quel'Danas. He says Kil'jaeden is being brought through the Sunwell and directs his troops to clear Legion fodder while supporting incoming specialists. He has served alongside some draenei at Skettis and in Shadowmoon Valley, and demands that sin'dorei recruits meet his standards or leave.
Anchorite Kairthos is a Shattered Sun quest contact on Quel'Danas. He requests a large donation supporting Anchorite Ayuri's efforts, with recognition among Shattered Sun fighters offered in return.
A Shattered Sun recruit serving on Quel'Danas, one of several recruits stationed in the area.
Archmage Ne'thul serves the Shattered Sun at the Sunwell gate on Quel'Danas. A warning associated with him says that Kil'jaeden's rise would bring a war on a scale unseen for 10,000 years.
Shattered Sun Archmages are senior mages of the Shattered Sun.
K'iru is a named presence on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Shattered Sun Dragonhawks are beasts associated with the Shattered Sun.
An Unrestrained Dragonhawk can carry a traveler back to Sun's Reach. The animal may appear unsettled by commotion nearby.

Shaani is a jewelcrafting supplier who works with the alchemist Mar'nah on unusually rare gems. Confident in Mar'nah's skill, Shaani hopes to recover gems thought lost in time. If their work succeeds, their collaboration pairs Mar'nah's transmutations with Shaani's work on the resulting gems.

Theremis is a vendor titled Keeper of Lost Artifacts, offering goods to browse. That title marks him out from the nearby specialty sellers, though the available records do not specify which artifacts he carries or what they mean to him.

Yrma is a vendor titled Transmuter of Sin'dorei Relics, offering goods to browse. Her title points to a specialty in Sin'dorei relics, distinct from the nearby artifact keeper and gear purveyors; the available records do not explain her methods or stock.

Kayri is an Exotic Gear Purveyor, a vendor whose title distinguishes her specialty from the artifact keeper and relic transmuter nearby. The records establish the vendor role but do not identify particular gear, its origin, or Kayri's personal views.

Karynna is an Exotic Gear Purveyor, a vendor whose title distinguishes her specialty from the artifact keeper and relic transmuter nearby. The records establish the vendor role but do not identify particular gear, its origin, or Karynna's personal views.
Olus is an Exotic Gear Purveyor, a vendor whose title distinguishes his specialty from the artifact keeper and relic transmuter nearby.

Soryn is an Exotic Gear Purveyor, a vendor whose title distinguishes his specialty from the artifact keeper and relic transmuter nearby. The records establish the vendor role but do not identify particular gear, its origin, or Soryn's personal views.
A Shattered Sun peacekeeper on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Ohura is a dragonhawk master who handles fast travel. When attacked, she summons an enraged felbat to aid her.

Thalorien Dawnseeker is a commander defending the Sunwell from the Scourge. He calls a stranger to stand with his soldiers, orders a withdrawal to prepare the Sunwell's defenses, and speaks of fighting for his people and prince.
The Warden of the Sunwell serves as a gatekeeper for entry to the Sunwell. It offers to escort a visitor inside when they are ready.

Halduron Brightwing is the sin'dorei Ranger General, protective of the Sunwell's sacred status and wary of unproven claims about Quel'Delar. Recovering the blade carries deep meaning for him and his people. He knows Thalorien Dawnseeker's history and requires the former bearer's blessing before admitting a claimant to the Sunwell, where he expects guests to behave respectfully.

These remains are identified as those of Thalorien Dawnseeker, Quel'Delar's last wielder. He defended the Sunwell against the Scourge and fell in the Dead Scar while buying time for his men. Halduron directs would-be bearers of Quel'Delar to seek Thalorien's spirit's blessing at the remains before gaining admission to the Sunwell.

place_records.text: You are in the Isle of Quel'Danas in the Eastern Kingdoms, land held by neither the Alliance nor the Horde. Sun's Reach Harbor is its one settlement, and the Shattered Sun Offensive works from a staging area and a sanctum against the Legion. Its main dangers are Dawnblade fighters, wretched fiends, ghouls and ravagers, Darkspine myrmidons, and Legion hellions and demons.
You are in The Dawnchaser on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where Dawnblade reservists are the danger.

You are in The Sin'loren on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where Dawnblade reservists are a danger. An unrestrained dragonhawk here can carry a traveler back to Sun's Reach, though the animal seems unsettled by commotion nearby.
You are in The Bloodoath on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where Dawnblade reservists are a danger.

You are in the Shattered Sun Staging Area on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where the Shattered Sun Offensive gathers against the Legion. A vendor works here, and Quartermaster Eldara Dawnrunner oversees supplies for the offensive. Vindicator Xayann devised replacement crystal cores for malfunctioning sentries, and Exarch Larethor, an Aldor draenei, insists that the Aldor and the Scryers must cooperate because neither can face the threat alone.

You are in Sun's Reach Sanctum on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where Captain Theris Dawnhearth directs efforts to secure the sanctum and restore its wards. Hostile crystal wards are a danger here, and a spirit healer offers a return to life for a price, presented as a choice.

You are in Sun's Reach Harbor on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where dragonhawks work close to the front. Ayren Cloudbreaker, a veteran dragonhawk pilot, supports air strikes against the Legion from here, and Ohura, a dragonhawk master, handles the flights out. Dawnblade hawkriders and crystal wards are dangers in the harbor.

You are in Dawnstar Village on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where Dawnblade summoners, blood knights and marksmen are the main danger. Wretched fiends and Dawnstar chargers are dangers here too, and an Erratic Sentry, a malfunctioning guard near Sun's Reach, reports a core overload.

You are in The Dawning Square on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where a fel portal stands in the middle of the square. Unleashed hellions and abyssal flamewalkers are dangers here, and crystal wards are dangers too.

You are in Greengill Coast on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where Darkspine myrmidons and sirens are the main dangers. Skeletal ravagers, frenzied ghouls and Sunblade lookouts are dangers too, and Greengill slaves are numerous here.

You are in The Dead Scar on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where skeletal ravagers, frenzied ghouls, wrath enforcers and eredar sorcerers are the dangers. Thalorien Dawnseeker, the last wielder of Quel'Delar, fell here defending the Sunwell, and his remains lie near the southern end of the Dead Scar.

You are in Sunwell Plateau on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where Ranger General Halduron Brightwing, a sin'dorei, is protective of the Sunwell's sacred status and wary of unproven claims about Quel'Delar. A Warden of the Sunwell acts as gatekeeper and offers to escort visitors inside. Sunblade lookouts and abyssal flamewalkers are dangers here.
You are in Sun's Reach Armory, part of Isle of Quel'Danas. Unleashed hellions, abyssal flamewalkers and irespeakers roam it, along with Dawnblade hawkriders and blood knights.
